answer: Randomness-Gated Admission Windows. Each epoch, a verifiable-random beacon (threshold BLS) selects a public terrace of admission slots; only identities assigned to that terrace may submit or transact that epoch. The beacon’s pulse is unpredictable until revealed, so attackers cannot pre-mine identities onto future terraces. Any identity outside its assigned window must wait for a nebula of future epochs, paying continuous idle hardware and registration costs while its chance of selection collapses.
